name: Sprigatito
flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
flavor: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
flavor: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

name: Fuecoco
flavor: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
flavor: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
flavor: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Quaxly
flavor: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
flavor: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
flavor: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Lechonk
flavor: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
flavor: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Tarountula
flavor: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops
flavor: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

name: Nymble
flavor: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Lokix
flavor: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

name: Hoppip
flavor: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

name: Skiploom
flavor: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

name: Jumpluff
flavor: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Fletchling
flavor: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

name: Fletchinder
flavor: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

name: Talonflame
flavor: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

name: Pawmi
flavor: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavor: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavor: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Houndour
flavor: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
flavor: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Yungoos
flavor: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
flavor: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Skwovet
flavor: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
flavor: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Sunkern
flavor: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

name: Sunflora
flavor: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

name: Kricketot
flavor: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
flavor: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Scatterbug
flavor: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavor: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
flavor: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Combee
flavor: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

name: Vespiquen
flavor: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

name: Rookidee
flavor: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
flavor: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

name: Corviknight
flavor: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Happiny
flavor: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

name: Chansey
flavor: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

name: Blissey
flavor: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Azurill
flavor: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

name: Marill
flavor: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

name: Azumarill
flavor: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

name: Surskit
flavor: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

name: Masquerain
flavor: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Buizel
flavor: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
flavor: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

name: Wooper
flavor: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Clodsire
flavor: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Psyduck
flavor: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

name: Golduck
flavor: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

name: Chewtle
flavor: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavor: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Igglybuff
flavor: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

name: Ralts
flavor: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
flavor: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Gardevoir
flavor: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Gallade
flavor: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Drowzee
flavor: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

name: Hypno
flavor: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

name: Gastly
flavor: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

name: Haunter
flavor: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

name: Gengar
flavor: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Tandemaus
flavor: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
flavor: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Pichu
flavor: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Pikachu
flavor: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Raichu
flavor: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

name: Fidough
flavor: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
flavor: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Slakoth
flavor: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

name: Vigoroth
flavor: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

name: Slaking
flavor: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

name: Bounsweet
flavor: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
flavor: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
flavor: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Smoliv
flavor: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Dolliv
flavor: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

name: Arboliva
flavor: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Bonsly
flavor: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Rockruff
flavor: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
flavor: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

name: Rolycoly
flavor: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
flavor: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
flavor: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Shinx
flavor: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

name: Luxio
flavor: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

name: Luxray
flavor: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

name: Starly
flavor: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Staravia
flavor: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Staraptor
flavor: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

name: Oricorio
flavor: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Mareep
flavor: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
flavor: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
flavor: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Petilil
flavor: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
flavor: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Shroomish
flavor: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

name: Breloom
flavor: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

name: Applin
flavor: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Flapple
flavor: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
flavor: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Spoink
flavor: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

name: Grumpig
flavor: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

name: Squawkabilly
flavor: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Misdreavus
flavor: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Mismagius
flavor: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

name: Makuhita
flavor: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
flavor: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Crabrawler
flavor: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabominable
flavor: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Salandit
flavor: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
flavor: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Phanpy
flavor: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

name: Donphan
flavor: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

name: Cufant
flavor: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
flavor: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Gible
flavor: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

name: Gabite
flavor: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

name: Garchomp
flavor: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Nacli
flavor: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

name: Naclstack
flavor: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
flavor: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Wingull
flavor: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Pelipper
flavor: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

name: Magikarp
flavor: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

name: Gyarados
flavor: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

name: Arrokuda
flavor: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavor: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Basculin
flavor: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Gulpin
flavor: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

forms.note: Violet-only in the wild. With The Indigo Disk, Scarlet players can trade for one with Jacq.

name: Swalot
flavor: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

forms.note: Violet-only in the wild. Evolve a Gulpin traded from Jacq (Indigo Disk).

name: Meowth
flavor: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

name: Persian
flavor: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

name: Drifloon
flavor: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
flavor: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

name: Flabébé
flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Floette
flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

name: Florges
flavor: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Diglett
flavor: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
flavor: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

name: Torkoal
flavor: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Numel
flavor: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

name: Camerupt
flavor: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

name: Bronzor
flavor: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
flavor: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Axew
flavor: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

name: Fraxure
flavor: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

name: Haxorus
flavor: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

name: Mankey
flavor: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

name: Primeape
flavor: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

name: Annihilape
flavor: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Meditite
flavor: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

name: Medicham
flavor: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: Riolu
flavor: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Lucario
flavor: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Charcadet
flavor: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Armarouge
flavor: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
flavor: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

forms.note: Malicious Armor is Violet-only, but Ceruledge can appear in 5★/6★ raids hosted by a Violet player.

name: Barboach
flavor: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
flavor: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

name: Tadbulb
flavor: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Bellibolt
flavor: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

name: Goomy
flavor: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
flavor: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
flavor: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Croagunk
flavor: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Toxicroak
flavor: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Wattrel
flavor: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
flavor: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Eevee
flavor: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

name: Vaporeon
flavor: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

name: Jolteon
flavor: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

name: Flareon
flavor: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Espeon
flavor: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Umbreon
flavor: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Leafeon
flavor: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Glaceon
flavor: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Sylveon
flavor: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Dunsparce
flavor: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

name: Dudunsparce
flavor: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Deerling
flavor: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
flavor: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

name: Girafarig
flavor: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

name: Farigiraf
flavor: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Grimer
flavor: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Muk
flavor: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Maschiff
flavor: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
flavor: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Toxel
flavor: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
flavor: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Dedenne
flavor: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Pachirisu
flavor: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

name: Shroodle
flavor: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
flavor: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Stantler
flavor: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Foongus
flavor: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
flavor: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

name: Voltorb
flavor: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Electrode
flavor: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Magnemite
flavor: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
flavor: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

name: Magnezone
flavor: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

name: Ditto
flavor: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

name: Growlithe
flavor: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Arcanine
flavor: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Teddiursa
flavor: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
flavor: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Zangoose
flavor: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

name: Seviper
flavor: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

name: Swablu
flavor: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

name: Altaria
flavor: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

name: Skiddo
flavor: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavor: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Tauros
flavor: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

name: Litleo
flavor: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
flavor: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Stunky
flavor: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

name: Skuntank
flavor: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

name: Zorua
flavor: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zoroark
flavor: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Sneasel
flavor: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Weavile
flavor: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

name: Murkrow
flavor: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Honchkrow
flavor: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

name: Gothita
flavor: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

name: Gothorita
flavor: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

name: Gothitelle
flavor: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

name: Sinistea
flavor: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
flavor: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Mimikyu
flavor: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Klefki
flavor: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

name: Indeedee
flavor: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Bramblin
flavor: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavor: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Toedscool
flavor: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
flavor: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Tropius
flavor: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Fomantis
flavor: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Lurantis
flavor: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Klawf
flavor: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Capsakid
flavor: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
flavor: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Cacnea
flavor: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

name: Cacturne
flavor: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

name: Rellor
flavor: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rabsca
flavor: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Venonat
flavor: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venomoth
flavor: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

name: Pineco
flavor: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Forretress
flavor: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Scyther
flavor: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Scizor
flavor: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Heracross
flavor: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Flittle
flavor: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
flavor: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Hippopotas
flavor: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
flavor: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

name: Sandile
flavor: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

name: Krokorok
flavor: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

name: Krookodile
flavor: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

name: Silicobra
flavor: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
flavor: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Mudbray
flavor: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudsdale
flavor: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Larvesta
flavor: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

name: Volcarona
flavor: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

name: Bagon
flavor: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

name: Shelgon
flavor: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

name: Salamence
flavor: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

name: Tinkatink
flavor: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
flavor: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Tinkaton
flavor: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Hatenna
flavor: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
flavor: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
flavor: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Impidimp
flavor: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
flavor: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Wiglett
flavor: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

name: Wugtrio
flavor: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
flavor: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Finizen
flavor: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
flavor: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Varoom
flavor: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavor: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Cyclizar
flavor: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Orthworm
flavor: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Sableye
flavor: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Shuppet
flavor: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

name: Banette
flavor: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Falinks
flavor: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Hawlucha
flavor: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Spiritomb
flavor: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Noibat
flavor: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

name: Noivern
flavor: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Dreepy
flavor: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
flavor: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
flavor: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Glimmet
flavor: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
flavor: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Rotom
flavor: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Greavard
flavor: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavor: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Oranguru
flavor: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
flavor: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Komala
flavor: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Larvitar
flavor: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
flavor: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

name: Tyranitar
flavor: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Stonjourner
flavor: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
flavor: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Pincurchin
flavor: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Sandygast
flavor: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Palossand
flavor: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Slowpoke
flavor: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

name: Slowbro
flavor: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

name: Slowking
flavor: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

name: Shellos
flavor: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

name: Gastrodon
flavor: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

name: Shellder
flavor: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
flavor: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Qwilfish
flavor: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Luvdisc
flavor: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

name: Finneon
flavor: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

name: Lumineon
flavor: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Bruxish
flavor: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Alomomola
flavor: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

name: Skrelp
flavor: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

name: Dragalge
flavor: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

name: Clauncher
flavor: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

name: Clawitzer
flavor: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

name: Tynamo
flavor: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavor: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Mareanie
flavor: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Toxapex
flavor: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Flamigo
flavor: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Dratini
flavor: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

name: Dragonair
flavor: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

name: Dragonite
flavor: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

name: Snom
flavor: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
flavor: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Snover
flavor: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Abomasnow
flavor: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Delibird
flavor: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Cubchoo
flavor: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Beartic
flavor: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Snorunt
flavor: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

name: Glalie
flavor: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Froslass
flavor: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

name: Cryogonal
flavor: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

name: Cetoddle
flavor: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
flavor: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Bergmite
flavor: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
flavor: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Rufflet
flavor: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
flavor: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Pawniard
flavor: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
flavor: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Kingambit
flavor: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Deino
flavor: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
flavor: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

name: Hydreigon
flavor: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Veluza
flavor: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Dondozo
flavor: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Tatsugiri
flavor: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Great Tusk
flavor: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Scream Tail
flavor: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavor: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
flavor: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
flavor: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
flavor: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
flavor: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Bundle
flavor: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Iron Hands
flavor: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Jugulis
flavor: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Iron Moth
flavor: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Iron Thorns
flavor: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Frigibax
flavor: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
flavor: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Baxcalibur
flavor: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
flavor: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Wo-Chien
flavor: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Chien-Pao
flavor: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Ting-Lu
flavor: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
flavor: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
flavor: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Iron Valiant
flavor: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Koraidon
flavor: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

name: Miraidon
flavor: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Spinarak
flavor: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Yanma
flavor: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Yanmega
flavor: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Quagsire
flavor: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Poochyena
flavor: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

name: Mightyena
flavor: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

name: Volbeat
flavor: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise
flavor: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

name: Corphish
flavor: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Sewaddle
flavor: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
flavor: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
flavor: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Cutiefly
flavor: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
flavor: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Ekans
flavor: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
flavor: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

name: Bellsprout
flavor: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

name: Weepinbell
flavor: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

name: Victreebel
flavor: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

name: Sentret
flavor: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

name: Furret
flavor: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

name: Dipplin
flavor: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Vulpix
flavor: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

name: Ninetales
flavor: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

name: Poliwag
flavor: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
flavor: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Politoed
flavor: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Hoothoot
flavor: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Noctowl
flavor: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Aipom
flavor: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Ambipom
flavor: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Swinub
flavor: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
flavor: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

name: Mamoswine
flavor: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

name: Seedot
flavor: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Shiftry
flavor: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Phantump
flavor: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavor: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Poltchageist
flavor: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
flavor: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Geodude
flavor: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

name: Graveler
flavor: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

name: Golem
flavor: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

name: Timburr
flavor: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
flavor: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Morpeko
flavor: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Munchlax
flavor: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Snorlax
flavor: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Lotad
flavor: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
flavor: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
flavor: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Nosepass
flavor: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Probopass
flavor: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

name: Grubbin
flavor: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
flavor: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
flavor: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Sandshrew
flavor: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
flavor: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Gligar
flavor: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Gliscor
flavor: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Vullaby
flavor: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Jangmo-o
flavor: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
flavor: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
flavor: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Koffing
flavor: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Weezing
flavor: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

name: Mienfoo
flavor: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

name: Mienshao
flavor: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Duskull
flavor: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

name: Dusclops
flavor: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

name: Dusknoir
flavor: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

name: Chingling
flavor: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Chimecho
flavor: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Slugma
flavor: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

name: Magcargo
flavor: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

name: Litwick
flavor: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
flavor: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
flavor: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

name: Cleffa
flavor: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

name: Clefairy
flavor: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Clefable
flavor: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

name: Feebas
flavor: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavor: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

name: Carbink
flavor: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Ducklett
flavor: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Cramorant
flavor: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Basculegion
flavor: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Ursaluna
flavor: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Okidogi
flavor: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
