flavor: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Fezandipiti
flavor: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Ogerpon
flavor: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Doduo
flavor: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

name: Dodrio
flavor: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

name: Exeggcute
flavor: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
flavor: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

name: Rhydon
flavor: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

name: Rhyperior
flavor: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Elekid
flavor: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

name: Electabuzz
flavor: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

name: Electivire
flavor: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

name: Magby
flavor: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Magmar
flavor: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

name: Magmortar
flavor: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Kleavor
flavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Blitzle
flavor: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Smeargle
flavor: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Milcery
flavor: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
flavor: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Trapinch
flavor: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
flavor: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

name: Flygon
flavor: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

name: Pikipek
flavor: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
flavor: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
flavor: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Tentacool
flavor: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

name: Tentacruel
flavor: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

name: Horsea
flavor: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
flavor: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Kingdra
flavor: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Cottonee
flavor: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Whimsicott
flavor: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Comfey
flavor: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Oddish
flavor: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavor: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
flavor: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Bellossom
flavor: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Chinchou
flavor: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
flavor: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Inkay
flavor: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

name: Malamar
flavor: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Dewpider
flavor: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
flavor: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Tyrogue
flavor: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmontop
flavor: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Drilbur
flavor: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Excadrill
flavor: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Espurr
flavor: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
flavor: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Minior
flavor: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Cranidos
flavor: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
flavor: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Shieldon
flavor: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Bastiodon
flavor: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Minccino
flavor: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Cinccino
flavor: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Skarmory
flavor: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Plusle
flavor: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

name: Minun
flavor: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

name: Scraggy
flavor: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
flavor: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Golett
flavor: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
flavor: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

name: Porygon
flavor: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

name: Porygon2
flavor: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

name: Joltik
flavor: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

name: Galvantula
flavor: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Beldum
flavor: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

name: Metang
flavor: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

name: Metagross
flavor: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

name: Seel
flavor: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavor: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Lapras
flavor: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Overqwil
flavor: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Solosis
flavor: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
flavor: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
flavor: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

name: Snubbull
flavor: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
flavor: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

name: Duraludon
flavor: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Archaludon
flavor: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Hydrapple
flavor: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavor: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Venusaur
flavor: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Charmander
flavor: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavor: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
flavor: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
flavor: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavor: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
flavor: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Chikorita
flavor: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

name: Bayleef
flavor: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Meganium
flavor: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
flavor: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Typhlosion
flavor: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
flavor: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

name: Croconaw
flavor: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

name: Feraligatr
flavor: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

name: Treecko
flavor: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

name: Grovyle
flavor: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

name: Sceptile
flavor: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

name: Torchic
flavor: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

name: Combusken
flavor: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

name: Blaziken
flavor: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

name: Mudkip
flavor: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

name: Marshtomp
flavor: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

name: Swampert
flavor: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

name: Turtwig
flavor: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Grotle
flavor: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
flavor: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

name: Chimchar
flavor: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
flavor: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Infernape
flavor: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
flavor: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Prinplup
flavor: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
flavor: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Snivy
flavor: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
flavor: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
flavor: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
flavor: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavor: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Oshawott
flavor: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott
flavor: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
flavor: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Chespin
flavor: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

name: Quilladin
flavor: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

name: Chesnaught
flavor: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Fennekin
flavor: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavor: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavor: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
flavor: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Greninja
flavor: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Rowlet
flavor: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
flavor: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Decidueye
flavor: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Litten
flavor: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

name: Torracat
flavor: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

name: Incineroar
flavor: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Popplio
flavor: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

name: Brionne
flavor: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

name: Primarina
flavor: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Grookey
flavor: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
flavor: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
flavor: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Scorbunny
flavor: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
flavor: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
flavor: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sobble
flavor: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
flavor: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
flavor: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Gouging Fire
flavor: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
flavor: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

name: Iron Crown
flavor: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Iron Boulder
flavor: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Terapagos
flavor: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Walking Wake
flavor: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Iron Leaves
flavor: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Pecharunt
flavor: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
